units.source_text: 源氏公子常常倾慕明石姬的琴艺，一度也不曾听赏，引为恨事。

en.t: Prince Genji had long admired Lady Akashi's skill on the koto, and he regretted that he had never once had the chance to hear her play.

units.source_text: 此时便对她说：“分携在即，可否为我弹奏一曲，以为临别纪念？”

en.t: At this moment he said to her, "Our parting is close at hand. Could you play one piece for me, as a keepsake of our farewell?"

units.source_text: 便派人将京中带来的七弦琴取来，自己先轻轻地弹出一个趣味幽深的曲调。

en.t: He then sent someone to bring the seven-stringed koto he had brought from the capital, and first played a soft melody himself, deep and subtle in feeling.

units.source_text: 深夜肃静无声，琴音优美无比。

en.t: Deep in the night all was solemn and silent, and the sound of the koto was incomparably beautiful.

units.source_text: 明石道人听到了，不能自制，也携着筝走进女儿房中来了。

en.t: The Akashi monk heard it and, unable to restrain himself, came into his daughter's room carrying a zither.

units.source_text: 明石姬听了琴筝，竟泪如雨下，无法抑止。

en.t: When Lady Akashi heard the koto and zither, tears poured down like rain, and she could not hold them back.

units.source_text: 感动之余，也取过琴来，轻轻地弹出一调，曲趣高雅之极。

en.t: Moved beyond words, she too took up the koto and softly played a strain whose feeling was extraordinarily refined.

units.source_text: 源氏公子以前听到藤壶皇后弹琴，认为今世独一无二。

en.t: Prince Genji had once heard Empress Fujitsubo play the koto and had thought it unmatched in the world.

units.source_text: 她的手法艳丽入时，牵惹人心，使听者闻音而想象弹者的美貌，真是高雅无比的妙技。

en.t: Her technique was brilliant and graceful, perfectly suited to the taste of the time; it captivated the heart and made listeners imagine the player's beauty from the sound alone, a truly incomparable art of elegance.

units.source_text: 现在这位明石姬的表演呢，风流蕴藉，典雅清幽，令人听了心生妒羡。

en.t: But Lady Akashi's performance now was richly graceful, restrained, elegant, and serene, stirring envy and admiration in anyone who heard it.

units.source_text: 她所弹的乐曲从来少有人知。

en.t: The piece she played was one that few people had ever known.

units.source_text: 长于斯道的源氏公子，也从来不曾听到过如此优美可爱而沁人心肺的曲调。

en.t: Even Prince Genji, accomplished as he was in this art, had never heard a melody so beautiful, charming, and deeply moving.

units.source_text: 弹到美妙动人之处，忽然停手。

en.t: Just as she reached the most exquisite and moving passage, she suddenly stopped playing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子尚未餍足，心中后悔：“数月以来，为什么始终不曾强请她弹奏呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji was still unsatisfied, and in his heart he regretted it: "For these past several months, why did I never press her more earnestly to play?"

units.source_text: 于是一心一意地向她申述永不相忘的誓愿。

en.t: He then poured out to her, with all his heart, his vow that he would never forget her.

units.source_text: 又对她说：“谨将此琴奉赠，在我俩将来合奏以前，请视此为纪念物。”

en.t: He also said to her, "I humbly offer you this koto. Until the day when we play together in the future, please regard it as a keepsake."

units.source_text: 明石姬即席口占，不加修饰地吟道：

en.t: Lady Akashi composed on the spot and, without embellishment, recited:
